_comment: WO-2 done-criterion 3 (2026-10-05 build brief). RUN 2026-10-05 after owner approval; PASSED.
the owner confirms the archive and the data are on the machine and approves runs.
Inference only: no training, no new artifact, the pinned archive is read and
never rewritten. Two commands, because the packaged PyTorch encoder needed for
the list comparison may exist only under tests/ (rule D7).

artifact.stored_layout: torch-packaged-encoder-v1 (no encoder_impl field; converted in memory on load)

acceptance.warm_recall_at_500: equal to the reference when both are rounded to 4 decimals
acceptance.cold_recall_at_500: exactly equal (cold users are popularity-routed and never reach the encoder)
report: the exact warm and cold differences from the reference
how many users' top-500 lists changed (membership vs order only), all users and warm users
acceptance.on_failure: the record is written first, then the run raises; stop and report to the owner

preconditions: the archive above exists locally with the stated SHA-256 (load_sasrec verifies it)
the DVC-pinned cold-start cohort parquet is present (the runner checks before loading data)
ratings come from the dev Postgres or from TWOTOWER_INPUT_DIR (CSV snapshot); either must reproduce the protocol hash, which the runner checks
no other src.training process is running

outputs.record: an MLflow run tagged sweep_label=wo2-converter-reevaluation, reproduction_passed, top500_lists_sha256; evidence under artifacts/sasrec/fastpath-reevaluation/<run-id>/ (retrieval-summary.json with the verdict, per-user-recall.json, top500-lists.json)

result.machine: the laptop CPU of record, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1, caffeinate -i; torch 2.13.0

inputs.cohort: data/synthetic/cold_start/v1/users.parquet regenerated with python -m synthetic.cold_start.generator --ratings-csv data/raw/ml-25m/ratings.csv; md5 9e0c978eff3d45f0985e9e0bbe0551d7 (45,337 bytes) equals the DVC pointer
inputs.artifact: a11af5ed0f0745f68572407237cfa4b9, SHA-256 verified by load_sasrec; stored layout torch-packaged-encoder-v1, converted in memory

record_run.tracking_store: local sqlite store artifacts/wo2-converter/mlflow.db, artifacts under artifacts/wo2-converter/mlartifacts (main checkout)
record_run.why_not_the_shared_store: the shared server at localhost:5001 has --default-artifact-root /mlartifacts, a container-local path the client cannot write; run 7c1d3377de164914bb5758a6c7fb9527 there logged every metric (identical to the record) and then failed uploading per-user recall. It is tagged failure_cause. Same failure mode as 833812ee in September.

ndcg_at_500.note: cold NDCG moved by -5.2e-6 under O-21's stable popularity tie-break (2026-09-06), not under WO-2; cold users never reach the encoder and cold recall is exact. Warm NDCG moved by -5.1e-10, consistent with the 36 order-only list changes below.

result.per_user_recall_vs_528b1451: identical for all 1,931 warm and 710 cold users; the 1e-16 aggregate difference is summation order

encoder_numerics_on_v1_weights.sample: 64 random left-padded histories at each of lengths 1, 3, 12, 49, 50

commands_as_run: python -m synthetic.cold_start.generator --out data/synthetic/cold_start/v1/users.parquet --ratings-csv data/raw/ml-25m/ratings.csv  # then md5 == DVC pointer

SASREC_RECHECK_SCOPE=converter SASREC_FASTPATH_RETRIEVAL_TRACKING_URI=http://localhost:5001 TWOTOWER_INPUT_DIR=data/raw/ml-25m OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 caffeinate -i python -m src.training.sasrec_fastpath_recheck  # run 7c1d3377…: metrics logged, artifact upload failed

MlflowClient('sqlite:///artifacts/wo2-converter/mlflow.db').create_experiment('phase-2-candidates', artifact_location='artifacts/wo2-converter/mlartifacts'); SASREC_RECHECK_SCOPE=converter SASREC_FASTPATH_RETRIEVAL_TRACKING_URI=sqlite:///artifacts/wo2-converter/mlflow.db SASREC_FASTPATH_EVIDENCE_DIR=artifacts/wo2-converter/evidence TWOTOWER_INPUT_DIR=data/raw/ml-25m OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 caffeinate -i python -m src.training.sasrec_fastpath_recheck  # run a2c3f5ac…, the record

SASREC_PINNED_MANIFEST=artifacts/sasrec/a11af5ed0f0745f68572407237cfa4b9/sasrec-manifest.json SASREC_V1_LIST_DIFF_OUT=artifacts/wo2-converter/list-diff.json TWOTOWER_INPUT_DIR=data/raw/ml-25m OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 caffeinate -i pytest tests/unit/test_sasrec_transformer.py -k pinned -s  # 2 passed
